Delete an entry. The entry stays in the database, so you can restore it with gournal restore.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | yes | Full id or the last 8 characters of the entry. |

## Output

This tool returns structured output. The shape is the [Entry result](/gournal/docs/reference/mcp/output-shapes/#entry-result).
